proposed_question.text: Which statement follows Section 311.4 of the Revised National Plumbing Code of the Philippines?

rationale.correct: Section 311.4 states the prohibition and names the exception path in Sections 812, 813, and 814.

distractors.A: Oversizing is not the stated permission.
distractors.B: Branch length is not the stated permission.
distractors.D: The same section says single drainage and venting systems with unvented branch lines are prohibited.

rationale.takeaway: Do not turn a vent into drainage or drainage into venting unless the Code exception is actually cited.

proposed_question.explanation: Revised National Plumbing Code of the Philippines, PRC Board Resolution No. 04-99, Section 311.4, PDF p.44.

options.text: A vent pipe may be used as a soil pipe if it is oversized.
A soil or waste pipe may be used as a vent if the branch is short.
No vent pipe shall be used as a soil or waste pipe, nor shall any soil or waste pipe be used as a vent, except as provided in the cited Code sections.
Single drainage and venting systems with unvented branch lines are allowed for small buildings.
